name: Letterboxd
description: Pulls your Letterboxd diary and reviews from the official RSS feed, matches them to items in your Jellyfin library, builds a taste profile from your ratings, and uses TMDB recommendations to suggest similar movies you already own — plus a list of movies worth adding. Results surface as a playlist, a sidebar page, and a dashboard config page.
overview: Letterboxd reviews, ratings and taste-based movie recommendations for your library.
